chats_expiry_idx.name: chats_expiry_idx
chats_expiry_idx.where: "chats"."expires_at" is not null and "chats"."deleted_at" is null and "chats"."purge_started_at" is null

composer_drafts_scope_check.name: composer_drafts_scope_check
composer_drafts_scope_check.value: ("composer_drafts"."scope" = 'new' and "composer_drafts"."chat_id" is null) or ("composer_drafts"."chat_id" is not null and "composer_drafts"."scope" = "composer_drafts"."chat_id"::text)

episodic_memory_metric_buckets_counts_ch.name: episodic_memory_metric_buckets_counts_check
episodic_memory_metric_buckets_counts_ch.value: "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."event_count" >= 0 and "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."error_count" >= 0 and "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."fallback_count" >= 0 and "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."recalled_count" >= 0 and "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."abstained_count" >= 0 and "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."item_count" >= 0 and "episodic_memory_metric_buckets"."duration_sum_ms" >= 0
